title: 27 Bible Verses About Anxiety (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about anxiety in the KJV and BSB, for anxious days and restless nights. Read each verse in context, free.
intro: Anxiety can make the whole world feel loud and uncertain. The Bible doesn't pretend that worry isn't real; many of its writers knew sleepless nights and racing thoughts. What they found, again and again, was an invitation to bring every care to God and to receive a peace that doesn't depend on circumstances. These verses are gathered for the moments when your mind won't settle. Read them slowly, maybe one at a time, and let them steady you.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Fear (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about fear and facing it, in the KJV and BSB. Promises of God's presence for when you feel afraid.
intro: "Fear not" is one of the most repeated phrases in Scripture, and it is almost always paired with a reason: God is with you. Fear shows up in many forms, from sudden danger to a quiet dread about the future. These verses don't shame anyone for being afraid. Instead they point to a presence that is bigger than whatever is looming. Keep a few of them close, and return to them when your heart starts to race.

title: 26 Bible Verses About Worry (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 26 Bible verses about worry in the KJV and BSB, including Jesus' words on not worrying about tomorrow. Free to read.
intro: Worry has a way of borrowing trouble from tomorrow and spending today's energy on it. Jesus spoke about this directly, pointing to birds and wildflowers as quiet proof that we are looked after. The verses here don't promise that nothing will go wrong. They offer a different place to set the weight down. If your thoughts keep circling the same concern, try reading one of these aloud and handing that concern over, even if you have to do it again tomorrow.

title: 26 Bible Verses About Strength (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 26 Bible verses about strength in the KJV and BSB, for when you feel weak, worn out, or at the end of yourself.
intro: Some seasons drain everything you have. The Bible is honest about weakness, and it often talks about strength as something received rather than produced. Prophets, poets, and apostles describe God renewing tired people, carrying the weary, and showing up most clearly when human effort runs out. These verses are for the days when you need more than you have. Let them remind you that running low is not the end of the story.

title: 26 Bible Verses About Love (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 26 Bible verses about love in the KJV and BSB, from "love is patient" in 1 Corinthians 13 to loving your neighbor.
intro: Love is at the center of the Bible's message, and it is described in surprisingly practical terms: patient, kind, not keeping score. These verses cover love between friends, families, neighbors, and even enemies, along with the love that makes all of that possible. They are often read at weddings, but they are just as useful on an ordinary Tuesday when someone is hard to love. Read them as a description of what love looks like in real life.

title: 26 Bible Verses About God's Love (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 26 Bible verses about God's love in the KJV and BSB. Read what Scripture says about how deeply and faithfully God loves you.
intro: It can be hard to believe you are loved when you feel ordinary, or when you know your own failures too well. The Bible speaks about God's love as steady, generous, and not earned. It describes a love that came looking for people, that holds on, and that nothing can finally separate us from. These verses are worth returning to whenever you feel overlooked or unworthy. Read them as if they were written to you, because in a real sense they were.

title: 24 Bible Verses About Healing (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 24 Bible verses about healing in the KJV and BSB, for anyone praying through illness, pain, or recovery. Free to read.
intro: Whether you are waiting on test results, recovering from surgery, or sitting beside someone who is sick, healing is rarely a simple topic. The Bible holds both honest cries for help and many stories of people made well. These verses speak of a God who cares about bodies and hearts, who binds up wounds, and who promises a day when pain is gone for good. Use them to pray, to hope, and to remember you are not facing this alone.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Grief and Loss (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about grief and loss in the KJV and BSB, for when you are mourning someone you love. Gentle words of comfort.
intro: Grief doesn't follow a schedule, and it doesn't always come with words. The Bible makes room for mourning: Jesus himself wept at a friend's grave, and the Psalms are full of tears. These verses won't rush you or tell you how to feel. They offer company in the sorrow and a quiet hope beyond it. If you have lost someone, or something, take whatever you need from them, and leave the rest for another day.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Peace (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about peace in the KJV and BSB: peace with God, peace of mind, and living at peace with others.
intro: Peace in the Bible is more than the absence of conflict. It is a settledness that can exist even when life is noisy, a wholeness with God and with other people. Jesus promised a peace unlike the world's, and the apostles wrote about a peace that guards the heart. These verses cover both the peace we receive and the peace we are asked to make. Read them when you need calm, and when you need the courage to be a peacemaker.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Faith (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about faith in the KJV and BSB, from Hebrews 11 to faith as small as a mustard seed. Read them free.
intro: Faith is often described as believing without seeing, but the Bible paints a fuller picture: trust that acts, holds on, and grows over time. Even the people closest to Jesus asked him to increase their faith, and one father famously prayed, "help my unbelief." These verses are for strong days and shaky ones alike. They show that faith doesn't have to be large to matter. It only has to be pointed in the right direction.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Hope (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about hope in the KJV and BSB, for holding on when things look bleak. Read each verse in context, free.
intro: Hope is what keeps people going when the evidence says to stop. In the Bible, hope isn't wishful thinking; it's confidence anchored in who God is and what he has promised. Many of these verses were written by people in exile, in prison, or in deep discouragement, which is part of what makes them trustworthy. If you are struggling to see a way forward, let these words hold the hope for you until you can hold it yourself.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Forgiveness (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about forgiveness in the KJV and BSB: being forgiven by God and learning to forgive others.
intro: Forgiveness runs in two directions in the Bible: the forgiveness we receive from God and the forgiveness we're asked to extend to others. Neither is always easy. Some of us struggle to believe we can be forgiven; others carry hurts that feel impossible to release. These verses speak to both. They describe a mercy that removes guilt completely and a freedom that comes from letting go. Take your time with them, especially if a particular name comes to mind.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Marriage (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about marriage in the KJV and BSB, for weddings, anniversaries, and everyday life as husband and wife.
intro: Marriage shows up on the Bible's first pages and its last, and in between it is treated as something both beautiful and demanding. These verses speak about becoming one, about patient and selfless love, and about faithfulness through ordinary days. They work well for wedding readings and anniversary cards, but they are perhaps most helpful in the middle of a hard week together. Read them as a couple, or on your own, as a picture of what a lasting marriage can be.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Patience (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about patience in the KJV and BSB, for waiting well, slowing down, and bearing with others.
intro: Patience is tested in traffic lines, hospital waiting rooms, and long seasons of unanswered prayer. The Bible treats it as a fruit that grows slowly, not a personality trait some people simply have. These verses talk about waiting on God, being slow to anger, and bearing with one another in love. They also remind us that God is patient with us. If you are in a waiting season, or just running short on patience today, these are for you.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Trusting God (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about trusting God in the KJV and BSB, including Proverbs 3:5-6. For when the path ahead is unclear.
intro: Trust is easiest when we can see the whole road, and hardest when we can't. The Bible's writers often spoke about trusting God precisely in the moments when nothing made sense. These verses invite you to lean on someone more reliable than your own understanding. They describe God as a rock, a refuge, and a faithful guide. Read them when a decision feels heavy, when plans fall through, or when you simply need to remember who is holding things together.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Depression (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses for depression and dark seasons, in the KJV and BSB. Honest, hopeful words for when you feel low.
intro: Depression can make even simple things feel heavy, and it can make hope seem far away. The Bible includes people who felt exactly this way: psalm writers who asked why their soul was so downcast, prophets who wanted to give up. These verses are honest about the dark and gentle about the way out. They are not a substitute for care from people who love you or from a doctor or counselor. They are a reminder that you are seen, and that this is not the end.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Encouragement (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 encouraging Bible verses in the KJV and BSB, to lift your spirits or to share with a friend who needs them today.
intro: Sometimes all a person needs is a reminder that they aren't finished, forgotten, or alone. The Bible is full of encouragement, much of it written to people facing real pressure. These verses speak of God's presence, his good plans, and the value of not giving up. They are also meant to be shared: the Bible tells us to encourage one another daily. Read one for yourself, then consider sending one to someone who has been on your mind.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Gratitude and Thankfulness (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about gratitude and giving thanks, in the KJV and BSB. For Thanksgiving, grace at meals, or any day.
intro: Gratitude has a way of changing what we notice. The Bible encourages giving thanks not only when things go well but in every circumstance, as a way of remembering that every good gift comes from somewhere. Many of these verses come from the Psalms, songs that were sung together by people who knew both hardship and blessing. Use them for a Thanksgiving table, a quiet morning, or a day when you need help seeing what is still good.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Prayer (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about prayer in the KJV and BSB: how to pray, why to pray, and God's promises to hear you.
intro: Prayer is simply talking with God, yet it can feel intimidating or awkward. The Bible offers plenty of encouragement here: invitations to ask, seek, and knock, assurances that God listens, and even the comfort that the Spirit helps when we don't know what to say. These verses include Jesus' own teaching on prayer. Use them to start your own prayers, or to remind yourself that no request is too small and no silence is the final word.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Family (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about family in the KJV and BSB, on honoring parents, raising children, and loving one another at home.
intro: Families are where we learn the most about love, and often where we're tested the most too. The Bible speaks to every part of family life: honoring parents, raising children with care, living in unity, and looking after one another. These verses aren't a picture of a perfect household. They are wise, warm guidance for real ones. Read them together around the table, or keep one in mind as you head into a family gathering.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Children (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about children in the KJV and BSB, for parents, grandparents, teachers, and baby dedications.
intro: The Bible calls children a gift and a heritage, and Jesus made a point of welcoming them when others tried to send them away. These verses speak about the worth of every child, the joy they bring, and the responsibility of raising them well. They are a good fit for baby dedications, birthdays, or a parent's late-night prayer. They are also a reminder that each child was known and loved before they were ever born.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Friendship (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about friendship in the KJV and BSB, on loyal friends, wise company, and loving like Jesus.
intro: Good friends sharpen us, sit with us, and tell us the truth when it's hard to hear. The Bible has a lot to say about friendship, especially in Proverbs, and it holds up examples like David and Jonathan and Ruth and Naomi. Jesus even called his followers friends. These verses can help you be a better friend, choose your company wisely, and appreciate the people who have stayed close. Consider sending one to a friend today.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Money (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about money in the KJV and BSB, on debt, generosity, contentment, and where your treasure is.
intro: Money touches almost every part of life, so it's no surprise the Bible talks about it often. These verses cover saving and spending, debt and generosity, hard work and contentment. They also warn about letting wealth become what we trust most. Whether you are budgeting through a tight month or deciding what to do with plenty, these passages offer grounded, practical wisdom. They ask a simple question worth returning to: where is your treasure, really?

title: 27 Bible Verses About Work (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about work in the KJV and BSB, for finding meaning, diligence, and rest in your daily job.
intro: Most of us spend a large share of our lives working, whether in an office, a classroom, a kitchen, or a field. The Bible treats work as part of what humans were made for, not merely a necessity. These verses talk about diligence, honesty, doing a job well, and finding satisfaction in labor, while also warning against overwork. Read them on a Monday morning, before a big project, or when your job feels like it doesn't matter. It does.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Wisdom (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about wisdom in the KJV and BSB, from Proverbs and James, for making good decisions in everyday life.
intro: Wisdom is the ability to see life clearly and choose well, and the Bible says it is available to anyone who asks. Much of what's collected here comes from Proverbs, a book of practical sayings about speech, relationships, and choices, along with the book of James. These verses are especially helpful before a big decision or when you feel out of your depth. They remind us that real wisdom starts with humility and is generous with those who seek it.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Courage (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about courage in the KJV and BSB, including "be strong and courageous." For facing hard things.
intro: Courage isn't the absence of fear; it's moving forward anyway. The Bible tells the stories of many reluctant heroes, and the command to "be strong and of a good courage" is usually given to someone who feels anything but. These verses are for job interviews, hard conversations, medical decisions, and any moment that asks more of you than you think you have. Their message is consistent: you won't be facing it alone.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Protection (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about God's protection in the KJV and BSB, including Psalm 91. Prayers for safety for you and your family.
intro: When someone we love is traveling, deployed, sick, or simply out in the world, it's natural to pray for their safety. The Bible describes God as a refuge, a shield, a fortress, and a shelter under his wings. Many of these verses come from Psalms written during real danger. They don't promise a life without trouble, but they do promise that we are watched over. Pray them for yourself, or put a loved one's name in them.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Comfort (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 comforting Bible verses in the KJV and BSB, for hard days, heavy hearts, and anyone who needs gentle reassurance.
intro: Comfort is one of the things the Bible says God does best. The prophets speak of him comforting his people like a mother comforts a child, and Paul calls him "the God of all comfort." These verses are for any kind of hurt: disappointment, illness, loss, or just a week that has worn you down. They are short enough to read in a waiting room or text to a friend. Let them be a soft place to land.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Salvation (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about salvation in the KJV and BSB: what it means to be saved, by grace through faith in Jesus.
intro: At the heart of the Bible is a rescue story. These verses explain, in the Bible's own words, what salvation is: a free gift from God, received through faith in Jesus rather than earned by being good enough. They speak about new life, forgiveness, and a future that cannot be taken away. If you're exploring Christianity for the first time or want to understand it more clearly, this is a good place to start. Read slowly and ask honest questions.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Grace (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about grace in the KJV and BSB, on God's undeserved kindness and the strength it gives each day.
intro: Grace is receiving a kindness you didn't earn and couldn't repay. In the Bible it describes how God treats people: freely forgiving, patiently helping, and giving strength exactly when it's needed. These verses show grace as both the starting point of faith and the daily fuel for living it. They are a relief to anyone tired of trying to measure up. Read them and notice how often the word "free" or "gift" shows up.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Joy (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about joy in the KJV and BSB, on a gladness that runs deeper than circumstances. Read them free.
intro: Joy in the Bible is sturdier than happiness. It can sit alongside sorrow, show up in prison cells, and grow through hard seasons. These verses describe joy as a gift from God's presence, a strength for weary people, and something worth choosing on purpose. Some are bright songs of celebration; others were written through tears. Read them on a good day to say thank you, or on a hard day to remember that joy will come again.

title: 26 Bible Verses About Rest (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 26 Bible verses about rest in the KJV and BSB, for the weary and burned out. "Come unto me, and I will give you rest."
intro: We live in a culture that rarely stops, and many of us feel it in our bodies and minds. The Bible sees rest as a gift and even a command, built into creation from the very first week. Jesus invited tired people to come to him and find rest for their souls. These verses cover both kinds of rest: stepping away from work and finding inner quiet. Read them as permission to slow down, breathe, and let yourself be refreshed.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Purpose (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about purpose in the KJV and BSB, for finding meaning, direction, and God's plans for your life.
intro: "What am I here for?" is one of the oldest human questions. The Bible answers it in a few ways: you were made on purpose, God has good plans, and a meaningful life looks like loving God and others in everyday ways. These verses are helpful at crossroads, such as graduation, a career change, or a season that feels aimless. They won't hand you a detailed map, but they will remind you that your life is not random.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Temptation (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about temptation in the KJV and BSB, for resisting it and finding a way out. Honest, practical help.
intro: Everyone faces temptation, and the Bible is refreshingly frank about it. It says Jesus himself was tempted, so he understands. These verses offer practical help: a promise that there is always a way out, encouragement to stay alert, and the reminder that falling short is not the end. Whether you're wrestling with a habit, a shortcut, or a moment of weakness, read these as allies in the fight, not as a lecture.

title: 26 Bible Verses About Anger (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 26 Bible verses about anger in the KJV and BSB, on being slow to anger, quick to listen, and handling conflict well.
intro: Anger is a normal human emotion, and the Bible doesn't call every flash of it wrong. It does warn about what anger can do when it is nursed, unchecked, or allowed to rule. These verses offer wisdom on slowing down, choosing gentle words, and not letting the sun go down on a grudge. They are worth reading before a tense conversation, after an argument, or whenever you feel your temper rising. Small changes in how we respond can change a lot.

title: 29 Bible Verses About Pride (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 29 Bible verses about pride in the KJV and BSB, including "pride goeth before destruction." On ego, boasting, and humility.
intro: Pride is easy to spot in others and hard to see in ourselves. The Bible warns about it often, not because confidence is bad, but because thinking too highly of ourselves isolates us from God and from people. These verses describe where pride leads and offer a better way. They pair naturally with the Bible's teaching on humility. Read them honestly, maybe with a particular situation in mind, and see what they bring to the surface.

title: 29 Bible Verses About Humility (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 29 Bible verses about humility in the KJV and BSB, on serving others, thinking rightly of yourself, and walking humbly.
intro: Humility isn't thinking poorly of yourself; it's thinking of yourself less, and of others more. The Bible's clearest picture of it is Jesus, who washed his followers' feet and came to serve rather than be served. These verses show that humility is the doorway to wisdom, grace, and genuine relationships. They are a quiet counterweight to a world that rewards self-promotion. Read them when you want to grow in kindness and in the freedom of not needing to be first.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Kindness (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about kindness in the KJV and BSB, on compassion, generosity, and treating others as you'd want to be treated.
intro: Kindness is love in its most everyday form: a patient word, a meal for a neighbor, a second chance. The Bible lists it as a fruit of the Spirit and ties it closely to God's own character. These verses include the Golden Rule, encouragement to show hospitality to strangers, and reminders that small acts done for others matter deeply. Read them and you may find yourself looking for someone to be kind to today. That's the point.

title: 29 Bible Verses About Loneliness (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 29 Bible verses about loneliness in the KJV and BSB, for when you feel isolated, forgotten, or far from others.
intro: Loneliness can happen in an empty apartment or in a crowded room. The Bible takes it seriously from the very beginning, when God said it wasn't good for the first person to be alone. These verses speak of a God who never leaves, who knows you fully, and who sets the lonely in families. They don't replace the need for real people in your life, but they do promise you are never truly alone. Read them as a companion for the quiet hours.

title: 28 Bible Verses About New Beginnings (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about new beginnings in the KJV and BSB, for a fresh start, a new year, or a second chance.
intro: A new year, a new city, a recovery, a second chance: fresh starts come in many shapes. The Bible is full of them, from mercies that are new every morning to the promise that anyone can become a new creation. These verses encourage you to let go of what's behind and to watch for what God is doing next. They are especially fitting for January, graduations, and moving days, or any morning you need permission to begin again.

title: 30 Bible Verses About Jesus (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 30 Bible verses about Jesus in the KJV and BSB: who he is, what he said about himself, and why he came.
intro: Who was Jesus? The Bible answers that question from many angles: prophecies written centuries before his birth, his own "I am" statements, and the reflections of those who knew him. These verses gather some of the clearest. They describe him as the Word made flesh, the good shepherd, the light of the world, and the one who came to serve and to save. Whether you're curious or have followed him for years, they are worth reading slowly.

title: 29 Bible Verses About the Holy Spirit (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 29 Bible verses about the Holy Spirit in the KJV and BSB: the Helper, the fruit of the Spirit, and the Spirit's gifts.
intro: The Holy Spirit can feel like the most mysterious part of Christian faith, yet the Bible describes him in warm, personal terms: a helper, a comforter, a guide into truth. These verses cover Jesus' promise of the Spirit, the events of Pentecost, the fruit the Spirit grows in a person's life, and the gifts he gives. They show that God doesn't just stand at a distance. He comes close, lives within, and helps us even when we can't find the words.

title: 28 Bible Verses About Heaven (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 28 Bible verses about heaven in the KJV and BSB: what Scripture says about eternal life, no more tears, and a new creation.
intro: People have wondered about heaven for as long as they have wondered about anything. The Bible doesn't answer every question, but what it does say is beautiful: a home prepared by Jesus, a place with no more tears or pain, and a new heaven and earth where God lives with his people. These verses are often read at funerals, and they offer real comfort there. They are also an invitation to live today with a hope that looks beyond it.

title: 29 Bible Verses About Death (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 29 Bible verses about death in the KJV and BSB, for funerals, memorials, and facing mortality with hope. Free to read.
intro: Death is the one experience every life shares, and it raises our deepest questions. The Bible is honest about its sting, yet it insists that death does not have the final word. These verses include words Jesus spoke at a friend's tomb, Paul's reflections on resurrection, and ancient poems about the shortness of life. They are fitting for funerals and memorials, and for any quiet moment when you're thinking about what lies beyond this life.

title: 27 Bible Verses About Mothers (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 27 Bible verses about mothers in the KJV and BSB, for Mother's Day cards, celebrations, and honoring the moms in your life.
intro: Mothers show up throughout the Bible, from Hannah praying for a child to Mary treasuring every moment in her heart. These verses celebrate the strength, wisdom, and quiet sacrifice of motherhood, and they remind children of every age to honor the women who raised them. Some describe God's own care in a mother's terms. They're a natural fit for Mother's Day cards, baby showers, or a simple thank-you note to a mom, grandmother, or mother figure.

title: 30 Bible Verses About Fathers (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 30 Bible verses about fathers in the KJV and BSB, for Father's Day, new dads, and anyone grateful for a father figure.
intro: Being a father is a privilege and a weighty responsibility. The Bible speaks to dads about patience, instruction, integrity, and tenderness, and it describes God himself as a Father who has compassion on his children. These verses include practical wisdom from Proverbs and the moving picture of a father running to welcome a son home. Share them on Father's Day, with a new dad, or with anyone who has stepped up to be a father to someone.

title: 29 Bible Verses About Leadership (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 29 Bible verses about leadership in the KJV and BSB, on servant leadership, integrity, wise counsel, and caring for people.
intro: The Bible's view of leadership turns many assumptions upside down. The greatest leader, Jesus said, is the one who serves. These verses speak to anyone responsible for others, whether a manager, pastor, coach, parent, or team captain. They cover integrity, seeking wise counsel, caring for people rather than lording over them, and the weight of being trusted with much. Read them before a big meeting, a hard decision, or the start of a new role.

title: 29 Bible Verses About Perseverance (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 29 Bible verses about perseverance in the KJV and BSB, for running the race, enduring trials, and not giving up.
intro: Some goals take years, and some trials last longer than we expected. The Bible often compares the life of faith to a long race, run with endurance rather than speed. These verses speak to anyone in the middle of something hard: a recovery, a degree, a difficult relationship, or a calling that feels slow. They promise that perseverance isn't wasted; it builds character and leads somewhere good. Keep going, one step at a time.

title: 30 Bible Verses About Sleep (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 30 Bible verses about sleep in the KJV and BSB, for bedtime, insomnia, and anxious nights. Read them before you rest.
intro: Lying awake at night can make every worry feel larger. The Bible has a surprising number of verses about sleep, many written by people who knew danger and stress firsthand, yet chose to lie down in peace. These are good to read at bedtime, on a sleepless night, or with a child before lights out. They remind us that God never sleeps, so we can. Pick one, read it slowly, and let your mind settle on it as you drift off.

title: 30 Bible Verses About Success (KJV & BSB) | Simply My Bible
description: 30 Bible verses about success in the KJV and BSB, on hard work, good plans, and what it really means to prosper.
intro: Most people want to succeed, but the Bible asks what success actually means. These verses include practical advice about planning, diligence, and seeking counsel, alongside promises for those who commit their work to God. They also add perspective: gaining the whole world isn't worth losing your soul. Read them before a launch, an exam, or a new venture, and let them shape both how you work and how you measure the result.
